_description: Example SMPL (WHAM Unity template) to UE5 Mannequin-style bone map. Target names follow common UE5 Mannequin/SKM_Manny naming; adjust to match your actual Mannequin FBX (use Blender to list armature bone names).
notes: L_Hand/R_Hand and extra Mannequin finger bones: leave at bind pose in v0 or add pairs after inspecting target FBX.
If your target uses spine_04/spine_05, remap SMPL spines to the closest three bones.
T-pose vs A-pose mismatch may require a pre-roll in Blender on the target rig (edit mode) or per-bone offset matrix (future work).
